targets.authors: Dupuis J, Langenberg C, Prokopenko I et al
targets.title: New genetic loci implicated in fasting glucose homeostasis and their impact on type 2 diabetes risk
targets.evidence_quote:
The MAGIC SNPs were supplemented by 13 additional SNPs from previously published GWASs (ESM Table 2) for a total of 29 SNPs that we attempted to replicate in our African-American cohort.
Dupuis	40195.0	Nat Genet	New genetic loci implicated in fasting glucose homeostasis and their impact on type 2 diabetes risk	Fasting glucose-related traits
targets.outcome_quote: Of the 16 SNPs recently reported in the MAGIC metaanalysis of over 122,000 participants [2], 12 were available for testing in the HUFS dataset (ESM Table 2). We directly replicated three SNPs (rs2191349, rs11558471 and rs4506565) located in or near DGKB-TMEM195, SLC30A8 and TCF7L2 genes respectively (Table 1). We also replicated SNPs from other GWASs for FPG: rs2722425 within ZMAT4 (p value=0.024) as well as rs625643 (p value= 0.048), which is located in a functionally unknown region on chromosome 1 (Table 1). SNPs from the remaining studies that did not directly replicate are not shown.
